sources.notes: ArcGIS Hub dataset 'County Parcels' (item 7975aabf6e1e42998a40a4b085ffefdf, layer 1): one row per tax parcel (PID) with attributes from a monthly extract of the property tax system (owner and taxpayer names, situs, property type code and name for up to four subrecords, year built, estimated market values, last sale). The Hub download endpoint on gis-hennepin.hub.arcgis.com redirects to hub.arcgis.com, which serves County_Parcels.csv (about 430 k rows; Last-Modified 2026-10-22). Both hub hosts: robots.txt Crawl-delay 60 (honoured), /sites/ /admin/ /sessions/ /groups/ /people/ /workspace/ disallowed. The county's own GIS server gis.hennepin.us (the live feature service and the attribute-table PDF County Tax Parcels.pdf) has robots.txt 'Disallow: /' for every agent, so the collector never fetches from it; the Hub is the county's published open-data channel. The platform's own terms (Esri ArcGIS Hub) should be read by a person (as for Socrata).
